name: Morgan Pestle
summary: In Stormwind, Morgan Pestle runs Pestle's Apothecary in the Trade District. He works with his brother William Pestle in Goldshire, handling supplies and alchemical research for the capital.

sections.title: The City Apothecary
sections.body: Morgan Pestle sells alchemical goods, reagents, and practical remedies at Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District. His brother William keeps a workshop at the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire, while Morgan tends their family trade in the capital. He receives supplies from the rural heartlands, including candles sent by William.

faq.q: Where can I find Morgan Pestle?
faq.answer: You can find Morgan Pestle inside Pestle's Apothecary in Stormwind City's Trade District.

faq.q: How is Morgan Pestle related to William Pestle?
faq.answer: Morgan Pestle and William Pestle are brothers who both work as alchemists in Elwynn. Morgan runs their shop in Stormwind, while William works in Goldshire.

faq.q: What role does he play in Elwynn quests?
faq.answer: Morgan receives the candles William sends north from Goldshire to Pestle's Apothecary and pays the courier well for delivering them.

angles.text: Morgan relies on fresh ingredients gathered across Elwynn Forest and beyond to supply his apothecary in Stormwind's Trade District.
If you arrive in Stormwind from Elwynn as an Alliance adventurer, Morgan's shop offers practical alchemical supplies and local city deliveries.
